title: Atlantis search: Atlantic region matching Plato's description

tellings.quote: we believe we found the a region in the u Atlantic that is uh fits all the descriptions of Plato's d in Plato's dialogues

plain: A former Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells Michels that he and a colleague named Maaneli Derakhshani believe they have found a place in the Atlantic Ocean that fits every description of Atlantis in Plato's dialogues. He does not say where it is. If he is right, Plato's sunken island would be a real place that could be searched.
